headline: Shanghai Launches Another Round of “Hu Eight Articles”: Before “Golden September and Silver October,” Down Payment for a Second Home Worth 5 Million Outside the Outer Ring Road Can Be 250,000 Lower
summary: Shanghai launched another round of property support measures, cutting the down payment on second homes worth 5 million yuan outside the Outer Ring Road by 250,000 yuan before the Golden September period.
why: Housing policy in China's largest city influences property demand, developer sales and the broader property sector.
